news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro (CLPT) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
news.summary: Management colour from the Q2 call detailed expectations for roughly 10 partner clinical data readouts and 10-15 enrolling trials over the next 18 months, plus plans to return Biologics and Drug Delivery to growth in Q3 as the new CAL preclinical facility ramps.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro: Regulatory Momentum Strengthens The Long-Term Investment Case
news.summary: Post-earnings analysis argues Q2 was weak (soft drug-delivery disposables, delayed CAL ramp) but regulatory clarity on partner uniQure's AMT-130 makes a 2027/2028 revenue inflection likely; flags dilution as a growing risk given cash burn.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
news.summary: Q2 revenue was $10.9M (+18% YoY) but missed the ~$12.7M consensus, with adjusted EPS loss of $0.38 vs. $0.29 expected; the company cut full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $48-52M and cash fell to $29.4M, sending shares down as much as 15-20% after hours.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Aug 2026 slides: $500m revenue target amid Q2 miss
news.summary: Alongside the Q2 miss, management unveiled a five-pillar growth strategy targeting $500 million in annual revenue, centered on becoming the enabling platform for cell and gene therapy delivery to the brain.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Congratulates Partner Aspen Neuroscience on FDA RMAT Designation for Sasineprocel
news.summary: Biopharma partner Aspen Neuroscience received FDA Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy designation for sasineprocel, an autologous dopaminergic cell therapy for Parkinson's disease delivered using ClearPoint's platform, supporting an expedited development pathway.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Results August 3, 2026
news.summary: ClearPoint Neuro confirmed it would report Q2 2026 financial results after market close on August 3, 2026, with a conference call and webcast to follow.

catalysts.label: uniQure AMT-130 BLA submission
catalysts.detail: Partner uniQure plans to submit a BLA for AMT-130 (Huntington's disease gene therapy delivered via ClearPoint's SmartFlow cannula/navigation) under the FDA's accelerated approval pathway, a key validation event for CLPT's platform.

catalysts.label: Biologics/Drug Delivery segment return to growth
catalysts.detail: Company guided that new CAL (ClearPoint Advanced Laboratories) preclinical services revenue should return the Biologics and Drug Delivery segment to growth in Q3 2026.

catalysts.label: ~10 partner clinical data readouts
catalysts.detail: Management guided to roughly 10 partner clinical trial data readouts and 10-15 trials enrolling using ClearPoint technology over the next 18 months.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly results release, per consensus/analyst tracking of ClearPoint's reporting calendar.

catalysts.label: IRRAS integration cost synergies
catalysts.detail: Company expects IRRAflow acquisition integration to deliver cost synergies reducing cash burn in H2 2026, potentially reaching cash-neutral in 2027.

catalysts.label: First CAL GLP services statement of work completion
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint's first signed GLP preclinical services contract at its new Torrey Pines CAL facility is expected to complete in H1 2027, unlocking additional biologics/drug-delivery revenue streams.

catalysts.label: Additional cell/gene therapies reaching commercial stage
catalysts.detail: Company believes multiple biopharma partners' positive FDA feedback could result in additional cell and gene therapies becoming commercially available by the end of 2027, driving CLPT's capital equipment and disposables demand.

pulse: ClearPoint Neuro's Q2 2026 results disappointed the market (revenue miss, wider losses, cash down to $29.4M), prompting a guidance cut to $48-52M for 2026 and a sharp post-earnings share price decline, even as management unveiled an ambitious long-term $500M revenue strategy. The near-term story is now a tension between weak core execution (soft drug-delivery disposables, delayed CAL ramp, rising cash burn/dilution risk) and strengthening long-term regulatory tailwinds, chiefly partner uniQure's AMT-130 gene therapy heading toward a Q3 2026 BLA submission using ClearPoint's SmartFlow/navigation platform. Investors are watching for the Biologics segment's guided return to growth in Q3, continued IRRAS integration synergies, and a wave of roughly 10 partner clinical data readouts expected over the next 18 months as potential catalysts to restore confidence.
